title: Install Python
summary: Python is the usual first programming language in this diploma.

steps.instruction: Open https://www.python.org/downloads/ and download the latest Windows installer.
steps.expectedResult: A python-3.x.x installer is in Downloads.

steps.instruction: Run the installer. Check the box that says “Add python.exe to PATH” before you click Install Now.
steps.expectedResult: Setup succeeds. The PATH box is the easy-to-miss step.

steps.instruction: Open a new terminal and check the version.
steps.expectedResult: Python 3.x.x prints. On some machines the command is py --version instead.

steps.instruction: Start and leave the interactive prompt so you know it runs.
steps.expectedResult: hello prints on the next line.
